title: Tap to check in for events: every event gets a door code the host prints or writes to an NFC tag, and a tap runs the existing check-in

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-19 ('tap to check in for events'). docs/LOYALTY.md section 6, ADR-1784

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-19. No migration. The Manage page's Home tab shows the event's door code while the host's check-in switch is on: a QR to print, a copy and download, and the same link stamped ?m=nfc to write to a tag. ensureEventDoorCode mints one qr_codes row per event (destination_type event, purpose event_door:<event id>, no owner) and reuses it. A tap lands on the /q resolver's event branch, which already sends a signed-out guest to the guest RSVP door and a member through checkInEvent (window, host switch, RSVP and ticket gates unchanged, event_attend paid). Nothing new runs on a tap.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];if(!/export async function ensureEventDoorCode/.test(r('lib/events/door-code.ts')))miss.push('no door code');if(!/destination_type: 'event'/.test(r('lib/events/door-code.ts')))miss.push('the door code is not an event code');if(!/withMedium\(url, 'nfc'\)/.test(r('lib/events/door-code.ts')))miss.push('no tag link');if(!/EventDoorSection/.test(r('app/(main)/events/[slug]/manage/page.tsx')))miss.push('the host sees no door code');if(!/readEventCheckInEnabled/.test(r('app/(main)/events/[slug]/manage/door-section.tsx')))miss.push('the door ignores the host switch');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-945: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
